documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration And Approval Of The Unaudited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter Ended September 30, 2026.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: ASK Automotive reported its strongest first quarter in revenue and profitability for FY27, marking the 11th consecutive quarter of strong performance since its listing. Management noted robust industry demand and volume growth, outperforming the two-wheeler industry production growth despite challenges from volatile aluminum alloy prices. The company is expanding its operations, including setting up a new plant in the South, scaling up captive solar capacities, and driving growth across its advanced braking systems and aluminum lightweighting solutions. ASK Automotive Limited reported its financial and operational performance for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, achieving a consolidated revenue growth of 52.1% year-on-year alongside increases in EBITDA and PAT. Management highlighted strategic developments including the implementation of technical collaboration with Kyushu Yanagawa Japan at the Karoli plant and the strategic closure of the low value-added Wheel Assembly business.

guidance.claim: The company expects to grow for the full year in high teens.
guidance.quote: We are confident that we will continue to grow not only in mid-teens, but we will be now growing for the full year in high teens.

guidance.claim: Export revenue is projected to see a 20% increase.
guidance.quote: Last year, we could not go near the target anywhere, but this time, we have given a guidance of 20% increase in the exports, and at the moment, we are still very confident we'll achieve it.

guidance.claim: Management expects the company to continue to grow around mid-teens in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are confident that will continue to grow around mid-teens in FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic demand remains robust and private consumption is resilient.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic demand remains robust, private consumption is resilient, and the Government of India's structural reforms, particularly GST 2.0, continue to energize the broader economy and, importantly for us the automobile sector, given its deep forward and backward linkages.

demand_outlook.claim: Two-wheeler production recorded a year-on-year growth of 22.8% in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: The two-wheeler segment, which is most relevant to us, recorded production growth of 22.8% on a year-on-year basis, with total two-wheeler production of 72.5 lakh units in Q1 FY27, up from 59.50 lakh units in the same quarter last year.

demand_outlook.claim: The company anticipates an improvement in EBITDA margins with aluminum prices expected to remain benign in upcoming quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: However, with aluminum prices expected to remain benign in the coming quarters, we anticipate an improvement in our EBITDA margins.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic about the medium-term industry outlook supported by improving consumer sentiment and expected benefits from the 8th Pay Commission.
demand_outlook.quote: We also remain optimistic on the medium-term industry outlook, supported by improving consumer sentiment, expected benefits from the 8th Pay Commission, and continued policy support for manufacturing and formalization through labor reforms.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic on the medium-term industry outlook supported by improving consumer sentiment and policy support.
demand_outlook.quote: We also remain optimistic on the medium-term industry outlook supported by improving consumer sentiment, expected benefits from the 8th Pay Commission and continued policy support for manufacturing and formalization through labour reforms.

capex_expansion.claim: The second captive solar plant in Bikaner is ready and expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner, Rajasthan is ready and is expected to be commissioned in Q2FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to set up a new plant in the South at Bangalore on a war footing.
capex_expansion.quote: That is the need that we have to urgently set up for the new orders that have come. We have to set up a new plant in South, that will be in Bangalore at a war footing, and we hope to operationalize it before March in this financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company operationalized a 9.9 MWp Solar Power Plant for captive consumption.
capex_expansion.quote: 9.9 MWp Solar Power Plant for captive consumption operationalized.

capex_expansion.claim: The second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatt in Bikaner is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatt in Bikaner, Rajasthan is progressing well and is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27, this reflects ASK's special focus on green energy.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to invest around Rs. 400 Cr in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: For next year growth of mid-teens, we need to invest around RS.400 Cr which we shall be investing in this year also.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue grew by 52.1% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: We delivered strong performance in business and recorded consolidated revenue growth of 52.1%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA stood at Rs. 164 crore with a 32.7% year-on-year growth and an EBITDA margin of 12%.
margins_costs.quote: We achieved EBITDA of Rs. 164 crore with 32.7% year-on-year growth. EBITDA margin stood at 12%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit After Tax (PAT) reached Rs. 85 crore, registering a 28.8% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: We achieved PAT of Rs. 85 crore with 28.8% year-on-year growth.

margins_costs.claim: Advanced braking system revenue grew by 48% year-on-year in Q1.
margins_costs.quote: Our advanced braking system revenue grew by 48% in Q1 on year-on-year basis.

margins_costs.claim: Aluminum lightweighting precision solutions revenue grew by 75% year-on-year in Q1.
margins_costs.quote: The aluminum lightweighting precision solutions revenue grew by 75% in Q1 on year-on-year basis.

margins_costs.claim: Safety control cable revenue recorded a growth of 20% year-on-year in Q1.
margins_costs.quote: The safety control cable revenue also recorded growth of 20% in Q1 year-on-year basis.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins were reported at 12.0% for Q1 FY27.
EBITDA margin was impacted during Q4 due to pass-through alloy prices.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin at 12.1%, however, this EBITDA percentage was impacted due to pass-through alloy prices as mentioned earlier.

margins_costs.claim: Input cost pressures arose from recent developments in geopolitical scenarios and significant minimum wage increases by state governments.
margins_costs.quote: Recent developments in geopolitical scenario and significant increase in minimum wages by some of the state governments has created an input cost pressure on the industry.

orders_capacity.claim: Confirmed orders for alloy wheels are around Rs. 70 crore to Rs. 90 crore for the current financial year and about Rs. 250 crore for the next financial year.
orders_capacity.quote: We have confirmed orders of about Rs. 70 crore to Rs. 90 crore depending on how the customer gear up for this financial year. However, for next financial year, we have confirmed orders of about Rs. 250 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the Bengaluru plant has reached 90%.
orders_capacity.quote: Very, very happy to share that Bangalore we have reached 90% capacity utilization that we set up last year, our 18th plant and the third plant in Bengaluru.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the Karoli plant is currently at 65%.
orders_capacity.quote: In the Karoli plant, the capacities utilization is still 65%, that is the reason that we have made investment for the alloy wheels.

capital_allocation.claim: The company expects internal accruals to be sufficient for funding capex, while external financing will be used for cash flow management.
capital_allocation.quote: We are actually keeping in mind our high mid-teen growth, our internal accruals will be sufficient; but yes, for cash flow management, we will have to take some external financing.

capital_allocation.claim: The company intends to use term loans for acquiring machines.
capital_allocation.quote: We will be taking term loan for machines.

capital_allocation.claim: Management remains confident that the debt-to-equity ratio will remain under control and not exceed 0.5.
capital_allocation.quote: We are still very confident that our debt equity will remain under control and it will be not exceed 0.5.

capital_allocation.claim: The board has recommended a dividend of 92.5%, amounting to Rs. 1.85 per equity share.
capital_allocation.quote: The board has recommended a dividend of 92.5%, that is Rs. 1.85 per equity share of face value of Rs. 2 each.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflicts created undue volatility in energy, commodity, and currency markets, sharply increasing aluminum alloy prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: As you are aware, after 28th February 2026, the geopolitical conflict in West Asia had created undue volatility in energy, commodity, and currency markets, and had led to a sharp, phenomenal increase in aluminum alloy prices, which affected our industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflicts in West Asia have disrupted the global economy and caused volatility in energy, commodity, and currency markets.
risks_headwinds.quote: After 28th February, 2026, geopolitical conflict in West Asia has disrupted the global economy, posing an unprecedented challenge in supply chain, creating undue volatility in energy, commodity and currency across the globe and it has started affecting Indian economy as well.

risks_headwinds.claim: Export revenue was affected by trade disruptions, higher tariff rates, geopolitical tensions, and supply chain issues.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our revenue from exports were at Rs. 141 Cr in FY26 against Rs. 147 Cr last year because of the trade disruptions due to higher tariff rates, geopolitical tensions, supply chain issues, logistic costs and other bottlenecks.

management_commitments.claim: The second captive solar plant in Bikaner is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner, Rajasthan is ready and is expected to be commissioned in Q2FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Export supplies to Ford Motors will be around Rs. 40 to Rs. 45 crore this year and are expected to rise to Rs. 60 crore next year.
management_commitments.quote: As regards your second question of Ford Motors, we will be doing exports of about Rs. 40 to Rs. 45 crore this year, and next year, it is likely to go up to Rs. 60 crore.

management_commitments.claim: The newly planned plant in the South will be operationalized before March in the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: That is the need that we have to urgently set up for the new orders that have come. We have to set up a new plant in South, that will be in Bangalore at a war footing, and we hope to operationalize it before March in this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Initial supplies of sunroof cables will start from H2, with substantial growth visible next year.
management_commitments.quote: Initial supplies will start from H2, but next year, you will see substantial growth there.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to invest around Rs. 400 Cr in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: For next year growth of mid-teens, we need to invest around RS.400 Cr which we shall be investing in this year also.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects revenue from the alloy wheel business to be around Rs. 90 to Rs. 100 Cr in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: FY27 we are expecting revenue of around Rs. 90 - Rs. 100 Cr and FY28 will be about Rs. 220 Cr.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
